🧠 Crypto News Brief: Bitcoin slips under $80K as the Fed meets, yet regulated infrastructure keeps advancing: Ripple secures its trust bank charter while wallet security failures and tokenized-stock pushback test market confidence. 📉 Bitcoin Slips Below $80K as Fed Meeting Begins Bitcoin drifted to around $79,750 on Tuesday, down about 2.5% over the week and lagging a rally in Asian tech stocks as the Federal Reserve opened its two-day policy meeting. Markets broadly expect rates to hold on Wednesday, while traders watch ETF outflows and the $79,000 support zone. Read full story 🏦 Ripple Wins Final OCC Approval for National Trust Bank Ripple National Trust Bank has received final approval from the U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, ten months after its conditional green light. The federally supervised bank can manage RLUSD reserves, act as collateral trustee for holders and offer digital asset custody, though XRP's price reaction was muted. More details 🔐 Keystone to Destroy Nearly 19,000 Hardware Wallets After Breach Hardware wallet maker Keystone will scrap 18,835 unsold devices and pause shipments after an October 20 website breach exposed about 26,000 buyer records and a device authentication key that could let counterfeit wallets pass checks. The company says recovery phrases and private keys were not compromised. The objections bar those third-party tokenized shares under the SEC exemption, putting issuer-consent rules under scrutiny.
